title: Cables and Cells
subtitle: Carrying and storing FE
text:
Each power block is a chassis with its own assembly, built like any machine: fit the assembly, then the control board, panels and worktop. Generators, batteries and machines keep their energy when broken.

The Power Cell goes into the Battery Module of a powered tool.
caption: Generator, battery, machine
